-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [NotificacionTicket] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_NotificacionTicket_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@CategoriaTicket_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Usuario_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @NotificacionTicketFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		NotificacionTicket_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @NotificacionTicketFilter (NotificacionTicket_Id)
		SELECT 
			[NotificacionTicket].Id
		FROM [dbo].[NotificacionTicket]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[NotificacionTicket].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @NotificacionTicketFilter (NotificacionTicket_Id)
		SELECT 
			[NotificacionTicket].Id
		FROM [dbo].[NotificacionTicket]
		WHERE
			 [NotificacionTicket].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([NotificacionTicket].[CategoriaTicket_Id] = @CategoriaTicket_Id) OR (@CategoriaTicket_Id = 0)) AND
         (([NotificacionTicket].[Usuario_Id] = @Usuario_Id) OR (@Usuario_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[NotificacionTicket].[Id],
		[CategoriaTicket].[Nombre] AS [CategoriaTicketNombre],
		[NotificacionTicket].[FechaCreacion],
		[NotificacionTicket].[CreadoPor],
		[NotificacionTicket].[FechaModificacion],
		[NotificacionTicket].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @NotificacionTicketFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[NotificacionTicket] 
			ON [NotificacionTicket].[Id] = filter.[NotificacionTicket_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[CategoriaTicket]
		ON [dbo].[NotificacionTicket].[CategoriaTicket_Id] = [dbo].[CategoriaTicket].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Usuario]
		ON [dbo].[NotificacionTicket].[Usuario_Id] = [dbo].[Usuario].[Id] 

 
END
